patch_description: The current ansatz uses redundant RZ-layering (pre and post) which essentially acts as a single rotation layer but with more overhead. By replacing this with a full SU(2) rotation layer (RX, RY, RZ) per block, we increase the expressivity of each block while maintaining the same parameter count. This allows the model to explore a richer Hilbert space at each re-upload step, likely improving convergence and accuracy.
